flights.code:
root = Stack([greet, picks, note, actions])
greet = Say("Found round trips for you + Sarah, out Wed Nov 25, back Sun Nov 29 — prices are **for both of you**. I skipped United's $398 fare since it leaves at 5:55a. All three below are nonstop.")
picks = Options("flight", [swa, amer, alaska])
swa = Option("Southwest", "Out Wed 9:40a→12:30p · Back Sun 4:10p→5:00p · free checked bags for both", "$486 total", "Best fit")
amer = Option("American", "Out Wed 11:15a→2:05p · Back Sun 6:05p→6:55p · bags $35 each", "$538 total")
alaska = Option("Alaska", "Out Wed 7:00a→9:50a · Back Sun 1:30p→2:20p · bags $35 each", "$412 total", "Cheapest nonstop")
note = Tip("Alaska's 7:00a start is the cheapest nonstop if you two can swing it — otherwise Southwest is the sweet spot, and its free bags save $140 vs American.")
actions = Buttons([Button("Book Southwest", "book_southwest", "primary"), Button("Show me the early ones too", "show_early", "ghost")])

rsvp.code:
root = Stack([greet, rsvp, tip])
greet = Say("Found it — **Lincoln Elementary Fall Festival**, Sat Oct 17, 11a–3p. I've mostly filled in the RSVP, just tap anything to tweak:")
rsvp = Form("rsvp", [adults, kids, mayaLunch, grownupLunch, volunteer, notes], "Looks good — send it")
adults = Stepper("adults", "Adults (you + Sarah)", 2, 0, 6)
kids = Stepper("kids", "Kids", 1, 0, 6)
mayaLunch = Choice("maya_lunch", "Maya's pizza lunch", ["Cheese", "Pepperoni", "No lunch"], false, "Cheese")
grownupLunch = Choice("adult_lunch", "Lunch for you & Sarah", ["Both cheese", "Both pepperoni", "One of each", "No lunch for us"], false)
volunteer = Choice("volunteer", "Volunteer slot (optional)", ["Bake sale", "Face painting", "Setup at 10a", "No volunteering"], false)
notes = Field("notes", "Notes for the PTA", "Allergies, questions, anything else?")
tip = Tip("Pizza's $6 each. Maya's cheese is pre-set — as always.")

bill.code:
root = Stack([msg1, total, history, msg2, why, note, next])
msg1 = Say("Ouch — I dug into it. The **heat wave** is the main culprit: your AC ran through **9 days over 95°F**, and that alone added **$58**.")
total = Big("$214.37", "October bill", "+$72 vs. your usual ~$142")
history = Bars(months, amounts, "$", 5)
msg2 = Say("The other $14 is smaller stuff: PG&E's new rate that kicked in Sep 1 (+$9), and this bill covered **33 days instead of 30** (+$5). So your usual ~$142 plus $72 of extras = $214.37. Annoying, but explained.")
why = Rows(rows)
note = Tip("Budget Billing would smooth all this out to about $156/month — no more spike months.")
next = Buttons([Button("Set up Budget Billing (~$156/mo)", "budget_billing", "primary"), Button("Tips to lower next month's bill", "lower_bill", "secondary"), Button("Got it, thanks", "done", "ghost")])
months = ["May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct"]
amounts = [131, 138, 152, 147, 142, 214.37]
rows = [["AC during the 9-day heat wave", "+$58"], ["New rate effective Sep 1", "+$9"], ["33-day billing period (vs. 30)", "+$5"], ["Your normal monthly usage", "$142.37"]]

email.code:
root = Stack([msg, draft, note, actions])
msg = Say("Dave needs to pick between **Tuesday** and **Thursday** morning. Tuesday clashes with your dentist at 9, so I'd go **Thursday** — you're home anyway. Reply's ready below:")
draft = Email("Dave Kline", "Re: Dishwasher still leaking", "Hi Dave,

Thursday morning works great — I'll be home working, so anytime between 8 and noon is fine. The side gate will be unlocked so the repair guy can get straight back to the dishwasher.

Thanks,
Joseph")
note = Tip("I added a line about the side gate being unlocked so the repair guy can get in. Say the word if you'd rather leave that out.")
actions = Buttons([Button("Send it", "send_thursday", "primary"), Button("Try Tuesday instead", "try_tuesday", "ghost")])

flyer.code:
root = Stack([note, flyer, extra, next])
note = Say("Done! Your **Garage Sale flyer** is ready — bright yellow, big headline, Saturday 8–1, 412 Alder St, and furniture, kids stuff & tools all listed.")
flyer = File("Garage-sale-flyer.pdf", "1 page · Letter · 240 KB", "pdf")
extra = Tip("Want a stack printed for lampposts or the community board? Just say the word.")
next = Buttons([Button("Text it to me", "text_flyer", "primary"), Button("Post to Nextdoor", "post_nextdoor", "secondary")])

topup.code:
root = Stack([msg, meter, fix, wait, note])
msg = Say("Quick heads up — you're at **84%** of your Personal plan this month. At this pace it runs out around **Oct 27**, and it doesn't reset until **Nov 1**.")
meter = Meter("This month's usage", 0.84, "12 days left until it resets")
fix = Options("fix", [topup, plus])
topup = Option("Top up $10", "Keeps everything running until the Nov 1 reset. Charged to your Visa ending 4242.", "$10", "Cheapest")
plus = Option("Move to Plus", "Double the usage, so you stop getting close to the limit every month.", "$50/mo", "Best fit")
wait = Buttons([Button("Do nothing for now", "wait", "ghost")])
note = Tip("If you do nothing, big jobs pause when the plan runs out.")
